q1: SELECT b1.name AS bar1, b2.name AS bar2 FROM bar AS b1, bar AS b2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT s1.beer FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND s2.beer = s1.beer)) AND EXISTS(SELECT s2.beer FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND s1.beer = s2.beer))
q2: SELECT DISTINCT s1.bar AS bar1, s2.bar AS bar2 FROM serves AS s1 JOIN serves AS s2 ON s1.beer = s2.beer WHERE s1.bar <> s2.bar AND ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT beer) FROM serves WHERE bar = s1.bar) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT beer) FROM serves WHERE bar = s2.bar))

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 checks for bars that serve all the beers served by another bar and at least one beer that no other bar serves. Q2 checks for pairs of bars that serve the same beer and have the same number of distinct beers served.
